pull.title: windows: replace deprecated codecvt with fs::u8path
pull.body:
## Summary
Remove std::wstring_convert/codecvt (deprecated in C++17, removed in C++26) in favor of fs::u8path().wstring() for UTF-8 to wide conversions.

This should be fine to remove since Bitcoin Core is now on C++20

comments.body: nit: Could use named args here for the bool literal while touching?

This code was originally [added](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/13886) to make `runCommand` handle UTF-8 command strings. Since https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/32380, the active code page is guaranteed to be UTF-8, so the narrow `::system()` accepts UTF-8 directly and the wide conversion is no longer needed. Therefore, the correct solution here is to revert 23db9546c16c2be264cfc4f695f5738a2f5beeeb
Given https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/32380, could we use a narrow `execvp()` here? Perhaps this will require templatizing `subprocess::util::quote_argument`.
Thank you for the review, this should now be resolved in [abb2983](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35704/commits/abb29836f5e8e04f6abb2b83ce4a532f291026e1)
